attributes.action: Create a fair settlement route for international graduates.
attributes.additional_details: International graduates invest significant time and money in the UK, often working legally while seeking graduate-level employment. Many struggle to secure sponsorship despite holding UK qualifications. We ask the Government to recognise lawful Student and Graduate visa residence, create a clear graduate settlement route, and protect current visa holders from unfair changes to settlement rules.
attributes.background: We call on the Government to count eligible Student and Graduate visa years towards settlement, create a dedicated ILR route for international graduates, and protect current visa holders through fair transitional arrangements.

rejection.details:

'Make all visa holders eligible for ILR after 5 continuous years of residency'
